meta.title: Services
meta.description: ItalBridge manages every stage of cross-border industrial procurement, from buyer qualification through after-sales support.

hero.title: A single accountable partner across the full procurement lifecycle.
hero.text: From buyer qualification through after-sales support, ItalBridge manages every stage of cross-border industrial procurement, so neither the manufacturer nor the buyer carries the coordination burden alone.

list.title: Six connected services, one commercial bridge.
list.intro: Each service is a distinct stage in the cross-border procurement process. In practice, they function as a connected sequence: the output of one stage becomes the input of the next. ItalBridge manages the full sequence so that accountability never transfers to a gap.

items.title: Buyer Identification
items.text: We identify East African manufacturers and industrial buyers with genuine equipment requirements, then verify their purchasing capacity, project timelines, and technical needs.

items.title: Manufacturer Representation
items.text: We represent Italian manufacturers in the East African market, managing enquiries, qualifying opportunities, and protecting brand integrity without the manufacturer needing a local office.

items.title: Commercial Negotiation
items.text: We structure and negotiate the commercial terms of each transaction (price, payment terms, delivery conditions, and contract clauses) on behalf of both parties.

items.title: Procurement Coordination
items.text: We coordinate the procurement process end-to-end (specifications, order management, production scheduling, and documentation) so nothing falls between the cracks.

items.title: Logistics Management
items.text: We manage freight forwarding, shipping documentation, and customs clearance, moving equipment from the Italian factory floor to the East African buyer's facility.

items.title: After-Sales Support
items.text: We remain the single local point of accountability after delivery, for installation support, spare parts, technical queries, and ongoing service coordination.

cta.title: Need a specific service?
cta.text: Tell us which stage of the procurement process you need support with.
